# MOVE-MAP erratum (LD-Q-125 B1, LD-Q-126): the law-class verbatim move, mechanical

**Status:** v2, answering REVIEW-r9.5-design MOVE-1 and MOVE-2 (LD-Q-135). It is generated by `make_erratum_v2.py` and rides in r9.6 as s4, under the verdict line `C2B1A-MOVE: ACCEPT | REQUIRED-FINDINGS`.

**What moves:** pure items, byte-identical, into lower crates. Each old file re-exports every moved item at its old path, at its old visibility. So every caller that names a moved ITEM by its old path compiles unchanged; a caller outside the new crate that reads a FIELD needs that field to be `pub`, which is exactly the declared field deltas below (LD-Q-135 MOVE-1).

**What may differ inside a moved item, and nothing else:**
- **item and method visibility:** `pub(crate)` or none becomes `pub`, because a crate boundary cannot re-export `pub(crate)`. The checker erases visibility ONLY at item and method positions.
- **field visibility:** compared token by token. A widening is allowed only as a declared `field_deltas` entry (field, old, new, the reason, and every reading or constructing site outside the new crate). Every other field keeps its old visibility.
- **declared per-row deltas** (`deltas` in the map): `seal` means a `crate::sealed::Sealed` supertrait (S.9).

**Proof:** `move_identity.py` lexes each item (doc comments kept; whitespace and plain comments dropped), removes only the tokens above, and requires equality. Its negative controls (one token changed) report DIFFERS.
